title: DashboardAuthoringRequest
description: Body of POST /api/authoring/dashboard (HEL-392, extended by HEL-397) — a user's natural-language goal, grounded in the caller's real workspace (HEL-371 context + HEL-365 panel-capability menu) and authored by Claude (HEL-390) into a validated DashboardProposal. Never applies the proposal — applying stays the caller's explicit, separate action via POST /api/dashboards/apply-proposal.

goal.description: The user's natural-language description of the dashboard they want (turn 1), or this turn's follow-up instruction when conversationId is present (turn 2+).

conversationId.description: HEL-397: omit for a fresh single-shot call (behaves exactly as before this field existed). When present, continues that owner-scoped, persisted conversation — the server loads its history and the current working proposal; the client never re-sends either.

AuthoringContextOptions.description: Optional overrides for the grounding-context assembly. Omitted entirely (or any field within it omitted) falls back to WorkspaceContextService's own default.

budgetBytes.description: Overrides WorkspaceContextBudget.DefaultBudgetBytes for this call's grounding context — mirrors GET /api/workspace/context's own budgetBytes query param (HEL-377).
